title: Clean stale Node and distribution wording
description:
Clean stale comments and documentation left over from runtime/distribution changes.

Known examples from review:
- A pack-loader comment still refers to Node 22 even though the project engine policy is Node 24.
- ADR/context wording still references npm distribution in places where README now describes GitHub Releases as the end-user channel and npm packages as private/internal for now.

Acceptance criteria:
- Search for stale Node 22 wording and update/remove it where no longer accurate.
- Search for stale npm-distribution wording and update it to reflect current GitHub Releases/private-package policy where appropriate.
- Preserve historical ADR context where it is intentionally historical, but add clarifying notes if needed.
- No behavioral code changes unless directly required by corrected docs/comments.
close_reason: Updated stale Node 22 and npm-distribution wording while preserving intentional ADR history.
